description: Safety policy enforced by `tools-offline-voice.py consent --action check`. This is an operator control, not legal advice; keep the underlying written authorization for any real-person voice.
disclosure_line: This audio was produced by a synthetic neural voice (offline, local). It is not a recording of a real person unless an authorized voice-clone consent record exists.

prohibited_uses.description: Non-consensual voice cloning of any person
Impersonation to deceive, defraud, or obtain money or credentials
Disinformation intended to mislead the public about real events
Content forbidden for AI-generated media in the deployment jurisdiction

minor_protection.rationale: No voice presented, described or targeted as belonging to a person under 18 may be synthesized.

real_person_rules.note: A consent record is created with: tools-offline-voice.py consent --action grant --speaker-name ... --grantor ... --scope ...

disclosure_requirements: Publish the disclosure line with any publicly released audio.
Keep the provenance sidecar (.provenance.json) next to distributed files.
cloning_note: This Skill Tool is not a voice-cloning tool. It ships one bundled synthetic voice (en_US-lessac-medium, MIT-licensed). Real-person cloning requires external tooling plus an active consent record, and remains the operator's legal responsibility.
